import { requirePrivateAccountMessage } from '@src/utils/privateAccountMessage';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { FormatGui, createQuoteMarkdown } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { getLoginWindowData } from '@src/response-apps/emailSecurity/login/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api';

export function createLoginReply(result: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getLoginWindowData>>, isPrivate: boolean, bid: string) {
  const content =
    result.code === 'OK'
      ? `UID：${result.data.playerId}\n临时密码：${result.data.temporaryPassword}\n有效期：${result.data.expiresIn / 60} 分钟`
      : result.message;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  const quoteMd = createQuoteMarkdown(content.split('\n'));

  md.addBlockquote(quoteMd);
  const reply = FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '网页登录', content: md });

  if (result.code === 'OK') {
    const url = new URL('https://tatian-online.alemonjs.com/login');

    url.searchParams.set('temporaryPassword', result.data.temporaryPassword);
    url.searchParams.set('UID', String(result.data.playerId));
    const buttons = Format.createButtonGroup();

    buttons.addButton('临时进入', url.toString(), { type: 'link' });
    const emailURL = new URL('https://tatian-online.alemonjs.com/login');

    emailURL.searchParams.set('UID', String(result.data.playerId));
    emailURL.searchParams.set('loginMethod', 'email');
    if (result.data.email) {
      emailURL.searchParams.set('email', result.data.email);
    }
    buttons.addButton('邮箱进入', emailURL.toString(), { type: 'link' });
    reply.format.addButtonGroup(buttons);
  } else if (result.code === 'PASSWORD_NOT_SET') {
    const buttons = Format.createButtonGroup();

    buttons.addButton('设置密码', '/设置密码 ', { type: 'command' });
    reply.format.addButtonGroup(buttons);
  }

  return reply;
}

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  if (!(await requirePrivateAccountMessage(e))) {
    return;
  }
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const result = await getLoginWindowData(e.uid as number, e.UserId, isPrivate, createBackendRequestContext(e));

  await message.send(createLoginReply(result, isPrivate, e.UserId));
});
